## Problem Statement
What capability gap, protocol standard, or developer workflow problem does this solve?

## Proposed Solution
Describe how the feature works across the CLI or the 5-port Host Contract (`9090–9094`).

## Open-Core Boundary Check
- [ ] This proposal belongs in the protocol-generic Apache-2.0 core socket (not a GUI/TUI view or a bundled third-party vendor catalog, which belong in extension packs or `Susi Commercial Apps`).
- [ ] Any new external dependency uses an `Apache-2.0`, `MIT`, or `BSD` license.
